segments.speaker: ithar
segments.transcript: "Then why did you call it losing the thread?"

segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
Because that sounded temporary.

Because threads can be found.

Because people who lose threads are still people telling stories.

I did not say any of that.

"Convenient phrase."

segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
I hated that sound.

I had hated it for four days.

Possibly longer.

"Ask me something."

Ithar considered.
